text:
Jake Neighbours tied a Blues record on Saturday, five assists in a 9-6 win over New Jersey, and that night sums up where his season is. He has 18 points in 24 games, 13 of them assists, and 10 points in his last ten, with nine of those helpers.

Here's the honest part. His own chances (5.0 expected goals) and his goals (5) match perfectly, so his shooting is real. The assists are the hot part: St. Louis has scored about 13 more goals than its chances deserve with him on the ice, and his scoring rate of 2.88 points per 60 sits above the top of our range for him. The Blues also get outshot at 5-on-5 when he plays (45% of shot attempts).

What stays is the edge in his game: 72 hits, and Evolving-Hockey had him taking chances away at an 87th percentile rate last season. The playmaking spree is fun. Expect it to cool toward a 55-point pace, which would still be a career year.
